Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

A find without a record is only an old object. Participants complete a context sheet, draw and photograph an object to scale, and write a catalogue entry, using the formats applied in field and museum practice.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Filling in a context sheet
  • Drawing and photographing an object to scale
  • Writing a catalogue entry

How the time is spent

  1. Recording protocol 35 min

    Context, material, scale and metadata.

    You: fill template

  2. Object/photo exercise 110 min

    Use replicas and documented images.

    You: photo log

  3. QA 35 min

    Check completeness and provenance.

    You: edited record

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Complete a context sheet recording context, material, scale and metadata.
  • Draw and photograph an object to scale, keeping a photo log.
  • Write a catalogue entry and check a record for completeness and provenance.
